drhp.business: SKSL manufactures precision stainless steel cold-rolled strips, coils, circles and sheets in the AISI 200, 300 and 400 series, from 0.08 mm to 2.00 mm thickness, at a single integrated facility in Reengus, Sikar, Rajasthan. It sells to dealer-cum-customer hubs for regional distribution and directly to OEM and end-user accounts, serving automotive, electronics and precision engineering, textile machinery, and consumer durables and industrial customers.

Reliance on a limited number of large customers and related-party counterparties in a dealer-led distribution model requires continued arm's-length governance and diversification efforts.

Disputes with counterparties can arise in the ordinary course of business.

risks.body:

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Expand manufacturing capacity to serve higher-value, tighter-tolerance product niches where technical barriers to entry are high and competitive intensity is comparatively low.
- Deploy net IPO proceeds towards debt reduction, working capital and capacity expansion.
- Continue arm's-length governance and diversification efforts to manage customer and related-party concentration.
